svg.title: Course planner illustration
svg.desc: Journal planner page with three quarter columns labelled FALL, WINTER and SPRING holding blank course blocks joined by prerequisite links. A FALL block marked with a pink X is moved by a curved arrow to SPRING, where it gets a check and a 検証済 seal. The robot-cat mascot holds a pencil beside it.
